Business.title: Business
Business.description: Represents a business in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Business entity.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns the business. (Relationship: User 1:N Business)

businessType.description: The type of business (e.g., shop, supermarket, food, service).

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the business was created.

onboardingCompleted.description: Indicates whether the onboarding process for the business is completed.

Inventory.title: Inventory
Inventory.description: Represents an inventory item within a business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Inventory entity.

businessId.description: Reference to the Business this inventory belongs to. (Relationship: Business 1:N Inventory)

name.description: The name of the inventory item.

category.description: The category of the inventory item.

unit.description: The unit of measure for the inventory item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the inventory item was created.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product within a business.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

businessId.description: Reference to the Business this product belongs to. (Relationship: Business 1:N Product)

quantity.description: The quantity of the product in stock.

inventoryId.description: Reference to the Inventory this product is associated with. (Relationship: Inventory 1:N Product)

isPublishedToMarket.description: Indicates whether the product is published to the marketplace.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product was created.

MarketProduct.title: MarketProduct
MarketProduct.description: Represents a product available in the marketplace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MarketProduct entity.

productId.description: Reference to the Product entity. (Relationship: Product 1:1 MarketProduct)

businessId.description: Reference to the Business that owns this product. (Relationship: Business 1:N MarketProduct)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the product was created.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to support the Busmo SME operating system, focusing on simplicity, security, and scalability. Authorization Independence is achieved by denormalizing the 'ownerId' in the 'businesses' collection to the 'inventory' and 'products' subcollections. This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, ensuring atomic operations and easier debugging. The `marketProducts` collection is segregated to allow public read access while restricting write access to the system only, supporting the required QAPs. The use of path-based ownership for user-owned data (businesses, inventory, products) ensures clear authorization and efficient security rules. The absence of custom claims (DBAC) and the use of explicit state modeling (e.g., 'isPublishedToMarket') contribute to a robust and maintainable system. The structure adheres to structural segregation by placing data with different access needs in separate collections (`businesses` with owner-only access and `marketProducts` with public read access).
